usage: cli.py ingest-prices [-h] --symbol SYMBOL --start START --end END
                            --out OUT [--meta-out META_OUT]
                            [--api-key-env API_KEY_ENV]
                            [--cache-dir CACHE_DIR] [--cache-only] [--refresh]
                            [--no-clobber]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --symbol SYMBOL       Ticker symbol
  --start START         Start date (YYYY-MM-DD)
  --end END             End date (YYYY-MM-DD)
  --out OUT             Output CSV path
  --meta-out META_OUT   Optional output metadata JSON path
  --api-key-env API_KEY_ENV
                        Environment variable for Polygon API key
  --cache-dir CACHE_DIR
                        Cache directory for raw provider responses
  --cache-only          Fail if cache is missing; do not fetch.
  --refresh             Refresh cached data from provider.
  --no-clobber          Fail if output file already exists.
